summary.intent: Improve the summary TUI layout by fixing spacing issues, left nav truncation, detail pane alignment, and enabling scrollable detail content without disrupting left nav navigation.
summary.outcome: All visual issues were fixed and committed: filter bar spacing, left nav width, detail section spacing, detail pane vertical alignment, 'Details' header label, and mouse/trackpad scrolling for the detail viewport.

repo: The summary TUI lives in cmd/entire/cli/summarytui/ with root.go (main model/view), detail_page.go (detail content rendering), keys.go (keybindings), and styles.go.
The viewport is initialized in newRootModel and resized in resize(); sizing must NOT happen in View() methods because value receivers mean changes don't persist.
verticalChrome constant must be updated whenever lines are added to the fixed UI chrome to keep content height calculations correct.
Detail pane tests use Contains assertions, making them resilient to spacing changes.

code.finding: renderDetailPane had a value receiver — viewport size changes inside it never persisted to the model. Viewport sizing must happen in resize() which has a pointer receiver.
viewport.MouseWheelEnabled must be set to true both at init (newRootModel) and after each resize(); omitting it silently ignores all mouse scroll events.
tea.WithMouseCellMotion() must be passed to the program for mouse events to be delivered to the Update function at all.
Detail sections (SUMMARY, FRICTION, LEARNINGS, INSIGHTS) were joined with a single newline; double newline needed for visual separation.

workflow: git checkout -- <path> restores deleted files from the last commit without touching other staged/unstaged modifications elsewhere.
When files are accidentally deleted unstaged, restoring them returns them to the last committed state — all in-session edits must be re-applied manually.
Always run tests after re-applying edits to confirm they were reconstructed correctly.

friction: User accidentally deleted files mid-session, requiring two rounds of git restore and full re-application of all edits.
The first restore only caught the summarytui files; a second restore was needed when tests revealed more files (dependencies) had also been deleted.
Mouse scroll silently did nothing because MouseWheelEnabled was false and tea.WithMouseCellMotion() wasn't set — no error or warning surfaced the problem.
Value receiver on renderDetailPane meant viewport sizing silently had no effect, causing overflow without scroll to work.
open_items: No open items explicitly deferred in this session.
